title: Duties on import and export levied by the Admiralty of Zeeland, 1579-1795
descriptions: This dataset contains information on the duties on import and export (‘convooien’ and ‘licenten’) levied by the Admiralty of Zeeland. Listed are the amount of the duties, the type of duty, the origin and destination of the imports and exports.
